notes.title: The Beast Update
notes.notes:
[p][b]DRILL RIFT UPDATE – THE BEAST RISES[/b]
[i]A unique new encounter, UI improvements, and more![/i][/p][p]Hey everyone![/p][p]First off, a huge thank you to everyone who played the demo and sent us feedback. Your thoughts have been incredibly helpful, and we’ve already put some of them into action.[/p][p]This update brings one of the biggest additions yet: [b]THE BEAST[/b] — a unique, punishing encounter that will test your planning and your dwarves’ sanity. Prepare to gain madness and face down a monster unlike anything else in the rift.[/p][p]We’ve also reworked the [b]Shipments UI[/b], making it clearer and more noticeable, plus added warning systems so you’ll always know when a shipment is on the way.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702728/6e9e5796e1b35287a4ae32d5a59b20007b2f6765.png"][/img][/p][h3]🔨 Currently in the Works[/h3][list][*][p][b]Click-to-skip dice rolls[/b] for smoother pacing.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tutorial improvements[/b] to help new players get started.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Balancing adjustments[/b] to accommodate the new monster encounter.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sound settings rework[/b] so you can adjust button volume specifically.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]📌 Planned Features[/h3][list][*][p][b]Items[/b] — new tools and resources to change how you approach the rift.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Localization[/b] — bringing Drill Rift to more languages worldwide.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Thanks again for all your support — and keep that feedback coming. Every suggestion helps shape Drill Rift into the best game it can be.[/p][p][b]ROCK AND STONE![/b][/p]

notes.title: DRILL RIFT DEMO OUT NOW
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]The demo for [i]Drill Rift[/i] is finally here! I’ve been working on this project solo for a while now, and it feels great (and a little scary) to finally put it in your hands.[/p][p][/p][p]I’d really love to hear what you think — what works, what doesn’t, and what kind of features or ideas you’d like to see as the game grows. Your feedback will help shape where [i]Drill Rift[/i] goes next.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for giving it a shot, and I hope you enjoy digging into the rift![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]WHAT TO EXPECT[/b][/p][p][/p][p][i]Drill Rift[/i] is inspired by retro management games and a bit of Dungeons & Dragons flavor. I wouldn’t call it a super hard game, but it will punish you if you don’t plan ahead.[/p][p][/p][p]It’s a turn-based management game where you drill whenever you can and deal with events that pop up, forcing you to assign and manage your dwarves. Each dwarf has different stats, and if one of them runs out of motivation — it’s game over.[/p][p][/p][p]Resources are key. You’ll need to upgrade buildings like the Coal Wheel to drill more often, or the Ironworks to unlock repairs and keep going deeper.[/p][p][/p][p]Enjoy managing your outpost, and follow along as the game grows into its full potential.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ROCK AND STONE![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]PD:[/b] I'm an artist by trade been working in the industry fulltime 5 years if people are interested on how I hand make the models of the game id happily share some behind the scenes do let me know if that is something that appeals you you! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45702728/a628525e8665b09c0f555f9ec1b6549850d5d8b9.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Dwarf strategy game Drill Rift shamelessly mines Baldur's Gate 3's dice rolls
notes.notes:
It's not often that you see a lot of crossover between strategy games and RPGs. Perhaps both will involve turn-based combat, or may touch on similar themes. But new strategy game Drill Rift has gone for a different approach: shamelessly mining Baldur's Gate 3's dice rolling mechanic. Put your pitchfork away, I'm not suggesting that Baldur's Gate invented rolling-that was obviously James Workshop in 1983-but the presentation of the D20 mechanic is practically identical in the two games.
